suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-13 adds this draft-primary relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. The systematic review and meta-analysis explicitly addresses cervical radiculopathy due to degenerative disc disease; the approved mapping is restricted to anatomically concordant cervical nerve-root disease. Require cervical degenerative disc pathology capable of nerve-root compromise and separately established anatomically concordant cervical radiculopathy. Do not infer radiculopathy from degenerative imaging, axial neck pain, nonspecific paresthesias, myelopathy, or peripheral entrapment neuropathy alone. Preserve peripheral neuropathy, plexopathy, entrapment neuropathy, spinal cord disease, nondegenerative structural lesions, and other causes as competing explanations. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
